content.title: Michigan blows out Arizona to earn spot in national championship game
content.text: Michigan blows out Arizona to earn spot in national championship game Skip to main contentMICHIGAN 91, ARIZONA 73Michigan rolls to national title game with its latest double-digit win over ArizonaBy EDDIE PELLS The Associated Press,Updated April 5, 2026, 1:01 a.m. Print this Article View Comments3Michigan forward Yaxel Lendeborg (right) high fives forward Will Tschetter late in the Wolverines' win over Arizona in the Final Four.AJ Mast/Associated PressINDIANAPOLIS — Game of the year? This wasn’t even the game of the night.Michigan overpowered Arizona early and humbled the ‘Cats for 40 long minutes Saturday, turning their highly anticipated Final Four matchup into a 91-73 Wolverines dunkfest-slash-highlight reel.Junior center Aday Mara scored a career-high 26 points and grabbed nine rebounds.
